A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to discover association rules from the semantic web, and that the discovered rules can be used to enrich ontologies and to suggest new axioms.

EDMAR is the only approach that is able to discover rules in the Semantic Web, that it can discover rules in an efficient way, that it can deal with noisy data, that it can take advantage of intensional knowledge and that it can discover more complex rules than any other system.
EDMAR is a novel evolutionary algorithm that discovers multi relational association rules from populated ontologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EDMAR is able to produce high quality rules that are more general, and therefore more useful for reasoning, than those discovered by the state of the art.
, by exploiting the evidence coming both from the assertional and the intensional parts of a populated ontology, EDMAR can discover rules that are not discoverable by the state of the art approaches.
, when applied on populated ontologies, EDMAR is able to discover rules that are more accurate, more general, and more numerous than those discovered by state-of-the-art systems.
